dogecoin.text: Just invested $5 million in dogecoin. I believe in it, I support it, and I'm gonna make it happen. Now where's the ROI on that yacht critic from 2015?
rypto enthusiasts are so gullible, chasing the next Shiba Inu or Dogecoin because it's trendy. Meanwhile, I'm over here making real investments that actually pay off. Their losses are my gains.
